actions.name: TARN
actions.text: EJ Corp’s proprietary Technical Automated Resource Network (TARN) is an AI model that assists in piloting the BD Freighter, allowing even rookie pilots to maneuver around obstacles with ease. The BD Freighter ignores up to 1 zone of Speed penalty.

actions.name: Run Blockade
actions.text: The BD Freighter diverts power to its generator and Boosts Thrusters while performing evasive maneuvers. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions, and the BD Freighter gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Primal Comms
actions.text: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.

actions.name: Living Starship
actions.text: See page 208.

actions.name: Primal Bond
actions.text: Trigger The UC Pod takes damage and has 13 or fewer HP; Effect The UC Pod gains fast healing 3, which ends when it has 14 or more Hit Points.

actions.name: spore pod launcher
actions.text: (1-zone burst, range 2 zones), Damage 1d6+3 acid (DC 14 basic Reflex save)

actions.name: Spore Cloud
actions.text: The UC Pod Boosts Thrusters, creating a spore cloud in each zone it leaves during this movement. The spore cloud lasts until the start of its next turn. Starships outside the spore cloud are concealed to starships inside it.

actions.text: See page 208.

actions.name: Primal Bond
actions.text: Trigger The UC Bloom takes damage and has 34 or fewer HP; Effect The UC Bloom gains fast healing 6, which ends when it has 35 or more Hit Points.

actions.name: Entwined Roots
actions.text: The UC Bloom restores 6 HP to a Pollinated starship within sensor range. If any of the crew members on board the target starship are affected by a temporary condition, such as frightened, reduce the value of the condition by 1.

actions.name: Petal Shields
actions.text: Frequency once per hour; Effect The UC Bloom unfurls its petals to block incoming projectiles. The UC Bloom gains 10 SP that last for 1 minute. While it has these SP, Medium and smaller starships behind a UC Bloom can Stick to Cover (page 208) as a pilot’s console station action (even if the starship doesn’t normally have the Stick to Cover action).

actions.name: Pollinate
actions.text: The UC Bloom releases nanomachines that attach to a starship in sensor range and transmit a magical homing signal. An unwilling target must succeed a DC 18 Will save to resist being pollinated.

actions.name: Dashadz Durability
actions.text: The Dashadz Wayfarer is more durable than it looks—and it looks extremely durable. The first time the Dashadz wayfarer is reduced to 0 Hull Points, it’s instead reduced to 1 Hull Point and regains 10 Shield Points. It can’t benefit from Dashadz durability again until repaired at an appropriate starship facility, a process requiring 1 day of work.

actions.name: Eject Garbage
actions.text: Frequency once per day; Effect The Dashadz Wayfarer engages its garbage ejection system, spewing weaponized debris behind it. All starships in a 2-zone cone in the opposite direction of the Wayfarer’s heading take 7d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 21 basic Reflex save. Entering an affected zone costs an extra 1 zone of movement for 1 round.

actions.name: Engage Lateral Thrusters
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect The Dashadz Wayfarer moves up to its Speed in any direction.

actions.text: Trigger The UC Gardenship takes damage and has 83 or fewer HP; Effect The UC Gardenship gains fast healing 10, which ends when it has 84 or more Hit Points.

actions.name: heavy spore pod launcher
actions.text: (1-zone burst, range 5 zones), Damage 2d12+6 acid

actions.name: Deploy Seed
actions.text: Frequency once per round; Effect The Gardenship deploys a seed in its zone. The seed is a small starship object with AC 20, 10 HP, Hardness 5, and object immunities. The Gardenship can have only three deployed seeds at a given time. If it would deploy a fourth, one of its previously deployed seeds is destroyed.

actions.name: Seed Migration
actions.text: Frequency once per round; Effect One deployed seed moves up to 2 zones within the Gardenship’s sensor range.

actions.name: Verdant Growth
actions.text: Frequency once per round; Effect The Gardenship orders a deployed seed within sensor range to burst into unnatural plant growth. Starships in the seed’s zone take 5d6 piercing damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save). Living Starship See page 208.

actions.name: Primal Comms
actions.text: As UC Pod. — [UC Pod: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.]

actions.name: Primal Astrofire
actions.text: The UC Arkship blasts a zone in sensor range with primal flame, dealing 6d6 fire damage in a 2-zone burst (DC 30 basic Fortitude save).

actions.name: Deploy Thorn Barrier
actions.text: The Arkship plants a barrier of rapidly propagating thorny vegetation between two zones within sensor range. Everything on either side of the barrier has cover from starships on the opposite side. All starships in the zones adjacent to the barrier when it’s first planted and starships that move through the barrier take 6d6 piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). The barrier is a starship object and has AC 10, 86 HP, and Hardness 10; it has object immunities and is immune to critical damage. It can also be targeted by any effects that can target a starship in either zone it’s adjacent to.

actions.name: Primal Bond
actions.text: Trigger The UC Arkship takes damage and has 95 or fewer HP; Effect The UC Arkship gains fast healing 20, which ends when it has 96 HP or more Hit Points.
